Seamless tileable module of a Chinese riverside residential tower facade at night, Yichang, Hubei, around 2010. A regular grid of six floors by eight window bays: pale grey-beige painted concrete and small ceramic tiles, dark aluminium sliding windows, projecting concrete balconies with laundry poles and split air-conditioner units, security grilles on the lower floors. Roughly one third of the windows are lit, mostly cool white with a few warm amber; the rest are dark with faint reflections. Subtle rain streaks, grime under sills, no exterior lighting fixtures. No text, no signage, no shop names, no people, no bridge, no landscape, no sky. Flat orthographic elevation, even diffuse light, photorealistic, tileable in both directions, muted teal-and-amber night grade, ordinary realistic Chinese apartment building, not a luxury tower.
